integrity: All proofs and computational checks are stated with their limits. All derivations are self-contained and do not rely on external certification. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns embedded monogenic submonoids with ambient identity of finite full transformation monoids. It does not count abstract isomorphism types, cyclic positive-power-only semigroups, partial transformations, or conjugacy classes. Brute-force checks stop at degree six; indirect exact computations stop at degree eighteen. Unindexed synonymous enumeration is a residual originality risk.
title: Embedded cyclic submonoids of finite full transformation monoids: exact refined enumeration and asymptotic generator uniqueness
